design.external_auc: ridge logistic fit on IMvigor210 anchor PC scores, predict external cohort; AUC + percentile bootstrap 95% CI (n_boot=2000, resampling the external cohort with fixed predictions, seed=20260911) [ verbatim]; BCa CI ( recovery auc_bca verbatim) reported alongside for anchor continuity
design.within_632_control: / verbatim Efron 0.632 optimism-corrected within-cohort AUC (n_boot=600, seed=20260911) for all three cohorts
design.lambda_rule: RE-SPECIFIED vs  to bitwise reproduce the frozen  recovery anchor: external transport lambda = 1/n_train = 1/298 = 0.0033557047; within 0.632 lambda = 1/N_total = 1/394 = 0.0025380711.  used a single 1/N_total for both. Ridge-layer perturbations set BOTH lambdas to the same value.

any_config_recovers_transport.definition: external AUC bootstrap 95% CI lower bound > 0.5 in at least one non-degenerate configuration (percentile engine CI primary; BCa reported alongside)

verdict.largest_variance_layer_scope: computed over the four primary layers (gene_set, normalization, pc_k, ridge_lambda), non-degenerate configs, mean variance across the two external cohorts
verdict.key_finding: Across 21 non-degenerate ablation configurations spanning gene set, normalization, PC dimension and ridge lambda under the recovered gene identity (320-gene panel, 0 all-zero genes), external AUC ranged 0.418-0.602 (GSE165252) and 0.513-0.679 (GSE78220). NO non-degenerate configuration yielded an external AUC whose bootstrap 95% CI excluded 0.5 under either the percentile or the BCa method -- the transport failure remains SYSTEMATIC under the recovered identity, not an artefact of any specific preprocessing choice tested. The largest cross-configuration external-AUC variance was attributable to the 'gene_set' layer (ranking: gene_set > pc_k > normalization > ridge_lambda). The  '70 unmeasured genes carrying 88.7% of PC1 loading mass' structural artefact is RETRACTED: under the recovered identity the anchor panel has 0 all-zero genes and the PC1 loading mass on (nonexistent) zero-genes is exactly 0; the 5 measured-only artefact configurations were removed (removal_reason recorded).
